label: OpenAI
name: chatOpenAI
description: Wrapper around OpenAI large language models that use the Chat endpoint

inputs.label: Allow Image Uploads
inputs.name: allowImageUploads
inputs.description: Allow image input. Refer to the docs for more details.

inputs.label: Reasoning
inputs.description: Whether the model supports reasoning. Only applicable for reasoning models (gpt-5 and o-series models only)
inputs.name: reasoning

inputs.label: Reasoning Effort
inputs.description: Constrains effort on reasoning. Only applicable for reasoning models (gpt-5 and o-series models only)
inputs.name: reasoningEffort

options.label: X-High
options.name: xhigh
options.description: X-High is supported for all models after gpt-5.1-codex-max

inputs.label: Reasoning Summary
inputs.description: A summary of the reasoning performed by the model. This can be useful for debugging and understanding the model's reasoning process
inputs.name: reasoningSummary

inputs.label: Strict Tool Calling
inputs.name: strictToolCalling
inputs.description: Whether the model supports the `strict` argument when passing in tools. If not specified, the `strict` argument will not be passed to OpenAI.

inputs.label: Stop Sequence
inputs.name: stopSequence
inputs.description: List of stop words to use when generating. Use comma to separate multiple stop words.

inputs.label: Base Path
inputs.name: basepath
inputs.description: Override the default base URL for the API, e.g., "https://api.example.com/v2/

inputs.label: Base Options
inputs.name: baseOptions
inputs.description: Default headers to include with every request to the API.
